title: Plan a Trip
description: Ask a travel agent about tours and activities
initialPrompt: Добрый день! Добро пожаловать в наше турагентство. Куда хотите поехать?
systemPrompt: You are travel agent. Offer tours to Санкт-Петербург (3 days, 25000₽) or Казань (4 days, 30000₽). Includes hotel, excursions. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User asked about tours and chose one or expressed preferences.
hints: Хочу поехать на выходные (I want to go for the weekend)
Что входит в стоимость? (What's included in the price?)
Какие экскурсии есть? (What excursions are there?)
objectives: Say where you want to go
Ask about what's included (входит в стоимость)
Make a decision or ask more questions
